question: ______ is a naturally occurring organic compound with the formula (C₆H₅)₂CO.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Benzophenone**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The organic compound with the formula **(C₆H₅)₂CO is Benzophenone**.
 
• It consists of two phenyl groups attached to a carbonyl.
 
• **Physical Properties**: Benzophenone is a white, crystalline solid and is slightly soluble in water but can dissolve in many organic solvents.
 
• **Uses**:
 
 
• Benzophenone is predominantly used in industrial applications.
 
• It is a common intermediate in the synthesis of many organic compound
